description: Without id: lists the model's sections (id, name, type, whether Section Designer can edit it) and the next free id. With id: returns a drawn section (VALUE/GEN, PSC/VALU, COMPOSITE-GEN) as outlines in section_preview's input format, in units (default mm), with its stored properties — edit it and write it back with section_write.
name: section_read
title: Section Designer — read sections from the model
